python_compatibility_followup.diagnosis: CPython3.10 rejects OSV ISO timestamps with1/2/4/5/7/8/9 fractional digits while Python3.12 accepts them. The unchanged public snapshot caused ValueError and exit1 in the previous reader under CPython3.10.21.
python_compatibility_followup.change: Normalize only the strictly validated temporary timestamp to6 microsecond digits before fromisoformat. Original advisory records, archive bytes/CRC and review hashes are unchanged.

status_page_editor_followup.trigger: StatusPage RSS custom-title assertion initially failed and then passed on CI retry after document-navigation synchronization was corrected.
status_page_editor_followup.diagnosis: Actual unmodified component edit/watch/save methods deterministically exposed inputs before the private-config ACK, then replaced typed RSS/analytics values with the old server snapshot and emitted those old values on Save. A pending public initialization could also overwrite private edits.
status_page_editor_followup.fix: Wait for the complete initial public snapshot and a successful current-connection private snapshot before exposing any editor control or accepting Save. Reject stale request/socket/slug/auth replies, retain same-user drafts across reconnect, keep explicit Edit retry on failed private load, and preserve pending Save redirects.
status_page_editor_followup.regressions: Actual component methods/watchers with delayed synthetic IO; existing CI dependency-security discovery. Baseline readiness test fails on135570ed; fixed regression and production frontend build results recorded locally.
status_page_editor_followup.e2e_policy: All original E2E assertions, timeouts and retries retained. No sleep, polling, skip or weakened assertion added.
status_page_editor_followup.limitation: The source race is reproduced; the exact CI save payload was not captured. Final natural Chromium CI remains the integration check.
